description: Processed synthesis inputs. Positive records include targeted reagent-name and temperature corrections in two holdout source records. Negative records omit product characterization/property columns and include source-verified reagent-name corrections as documented below. Source row order is preserved.

files.transformation: Removed the four local file-path columns. Seven cells across zero-based source rows 2966 and 8310 contain the requested holdout corrections: metal_1 AlCl3 to AlCl36H2O, modulator_1 to NaOH, and temperature 100 to 120 degrees C in row 2966; solvent_main to N,N-dimethylformamide and temperature 50 to 100 degrees C in row 8310. Both temperature_c_text values agree with temperature_c. All other retained cell values and source row order are preserved. UTF-8 byte-order mark included for spreadsheet compatibility.

Removed the four local file-path columns and, on 2026-09-28, thirteen product characterization/property columns from negative attempts. All retained cell strings, header order, and source row order preserved. UTF-8 byte-order mark included for spreadsheet compatibility. Subsequent source-verified corrections update 46 reagent-name cells only; all other retained cells, column order and row order are unchanged.

previous_export.transformation: Removed only the four local file-path columns. All remaining cell values and source row order preserved. UTF-8 byte-order mark included for spreadsheet compatibility.

property_column_removal.reason: Negative attempts must not carry successful-product characterization/property fields.
